# runzero_sso_group_mapping (Resource)

Manages a RunZero SSO group mapping.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The RunZero group ID to map to.
- `sso_attribute` (String) The SSO attribute name for this mapping.
- `sso_value` (String) The SSO attribute value for this mapping.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the SSO group mapping.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the SSO group mapping was created.
- `created_by_email` (String) Email of the user who created the mapping.
- `group_name` (String) The name of the mapped group (read-only).
- `id` (String) The UUID of the SSO group mapping.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the SSO group mapping was last updated.
